question: How a Scrolling block draws and moves its text: the path the words run on, how fast and which way they move at each Speed and Direction, what Wave Intensity, Text Size and the block width do to the path, what Fade edges draws, and whether Pause on hover pauses in the editor (oracleE probes, a new Scrolling block on Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, nothing saved, each run left by Exit Without Saving).

pointsAre: [length along the path, x and y in the path, x and y from the block top left]
answer: The words run along an SVG path inside the block; the path starts 550 left of the block and ends at 550 times ceil((W + 550) / 550), W the block width (2750 long at 1399.8 and 1324.8 and 1177.6, 2200 at 1012, 1650 on the phone at 376.7).

They move by the text path start offset, 60 px a second at 1x, 120 at 2x, 30 at 0.5x; left makes it fall, right rise; it stays between minus one set (the items and their gaps) and 0, wrapping. Read in scroll2-a, scroll3-a, scroll4-a.

Wave Intensity A is the path's height top to bottom: flat at 0; the path starts at its top at -550, is at its bottom at 0 and every 1100 after, at its top 550 after each; the first half is a cubic from the top through (188, A/2) and (422, A) to (550, A) from its start, the later halves leave and end flat with control points at a third and two thirds. Fitted on the points within 0.05 px.

The path's flat line sits 0.662 h below the drawing's top, h the rounded line height (34 at 24.4 px, 93 at Medium 66.4, 187 at Large 133.6, 30 on the phone); the drawing is h + A high, moved down 0.1 h, the path a further 0.05 h.
Each item sits at the sum of the rounded widths before it and one gap each, a gap being Item Spacing in em of the font size (12.2 at 0.5em and 24.4 px).
Fade edges masks the display with a gradient to the right: clear at 0, black from 15 to 85 percent, clear at 100 (two reads).
Pause on hover: with it on and the mouse on the block the words still move in the editor (two reads, 60 px a second).
